The winner of the Open race was never in doubt, for Jones, now 41 years of age, defied the heat to win by a wide margin in the very good time of 1hr.56m.7s. Second was Ken Honney of Walton in 2h.0[illegible]m.44s. and third, P.
Walton's Ken Honney was a fine winner of the 10th Belgrave Open '20', scoring a well-deserved victory over Hicks of T.V.H. in 1hr. 50mins 13 secs. - the fifth fastest time on record.

In what was for us a not too encouraging afternoon's sport, Chris Steer stood out. Only 18 years of age, he was 15th out of 46 finishers and beat in such men as Phil Vivian, Ken Honney and Geoff Winchester.
